text:
Iko Mbaụwa nke FIFA nke 1970, nke e mere site na 31 May ruo 21 June, bụ nke mbụ e mere na Mexico na nke mbụ e mere na mpụga Europe ma ọ bụ South America. Ndị otu iri na isii sonyere na ya, nke e kewara n’ime òtù anọ nke anọ maka egwuregwu round-robin, ebe ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla na-aga n’ọkwa knockout nke quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu ọnọdụ nke atọ, na nke ikpeazụ. Ọ bụ mbipụta dị ịrịba ama maka ụwa na-ele anya: n’ime Iko Mbaụwa mbụ ndị a na-agbasa na agba na nke mbụ e bufere site na satellite n’ụwa niile, yana ngụkọta ndị bịara bụ 1,603,975 n’ofe asọmpi ahụ, nkezi nke ihe dị ka 50,124 kwa egwuregwu. Ọ bụkwa Iko Mbaụwa mbụ nke e jiri kaadị edo na uhie mee ihe.

Brazil, nke nwere aha ọma site na mmeri 1958 na 1962, gafere asọmpi ahụ n’enweghị mmeri, merie egwuregwu isii ha niile n’ụzọ e wetara iko. A kpọrọ Pelé onye egwuregwu kacha pụta ìhè n’asọmpi ahụ, ebe ọkwa otu mere ka otu onyinyo dị ogologo ndụ nke bọọlụ pụta mgbe onye nche bọọlụ England Gordon Banks gbochiri isi Pelé site na nchekwa a na-echeta dị ka otu n’ime ndị kacha mma n’akụkọ ihe mere eme nke egwuregwu ahụ. Ọkwa knockout wetara ihe ọzọ dị ịtụnanya: mmeri Italy 4-3 meriri West Germany mgbe oge agbakwunyere na semi-final, asọmpi a na-eme ememe kemgbe ahụ dị ka ‘Game of the Century.’

Nke ikpeazụ, nke e mere na Estadio Azteca na Mexico City, dọtara igwe mmadụ 107,412 ma tinye Brazil megide Italy. Pelé gbara Brazil n’isi na nkeji 18 tupu Roberto Boninsegna hata ọkpụkpụ maka Italy na nkeji 37. Brazil meriri nkeji nke abụọ site na Gérson (66’) na Jairzinho (71’), ebe Carlos Alberto mechara mmeri 4-1 na nkeji 86 site na goolu nke mechiri mmegharị otu na-asọpụta nke a na-ewere dị ka otu n’ime ihe kacha pụta ìhè na Iko Mbaụwa. Brazil bụ ndị mmeri nke ugboro atọ, n’ihu ndị bịara nke abụọ Italy na ndị bịara nke atọ West Germany, onye Gerd Müller mechara dị ka onye kacha gbaa goolu iri. Mmeri nke atọ mere ka Brazil nwee ikike ijide Jules Rimet Trophy kpamkpam, mba mbụ mere ya.
